plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: choose which skills and MCP servers each workspace may use
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-workspace-capabilities 按工作区选择可用的技能（skill）和 MCP 服务器的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。 在侧栏工作区行的「…」菜单里多一项 **技能与 MCP**，点击后弹出窗口，勾选该工作区要用的技能和 MCP 服务器。取消勾选的项目不会提供给该工作区的会话，从下一轮对话起生效，无需重启。 ## 插件界面 支持在工作区里面设置skill与mcp，可以有效的规避工具上下文占用或其他特需需求场景 ## 行为 - **技能**：取消勾选的技能从会话的技能目录中消失，`skill` 工具和 `/技能名` 都无法再加载它。 - **MCP**：取消勾选的服务器，其全部 `mcp__<服务器>__*` 工具对该工作区的会话（含子代理）隐藏；服务器本身保持连接，其他工作区不受影响。 - 默认全部启用。保存的是「禁用列表」，所以之后新装的技能、新加的 MCP 服务器默认可用。 - 选择按工作区路径保存在 `$DSH_HOME/workspace-capabilities.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/workspace-capabilities.json`）： ```json { "version": 1, "workspaces": { "/path/to/project": { "disabledSkills": ["some-skill"], "disabledMcpServers": ["github"] } } } ``` ## 安装 先退出桌面版 DSH NEXT，然后： ```bash ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 DSH_HOME="$HOME/.dsh" "/Applications/DSH NEXT.app/Contents/MacOS/DSH NEXT" --expose-internals "/Applications/DSH NEXT.app/Contents/Resources/app/lib/plugin-cli.js" desktop add github:Fleey/dsh-workspace-capabilities ``` 重新打开 DSH NEXT 即可。卸载把 `add github:...` 换成 `remove dsh-workspace-capabilities`。本地开发可改用 `add link:/path/to/clone`。 命令行版（Web profile）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:Fleey/dsh-workspace-capabilities ``` ## 实现说明 - 工作区「…」菜单是写死的两项（重命名 / 删除），没有扩展 slot，所以浏览器端通过 DOM 注入：菜单弹出时复制「重命名」一行并插入，点击后关闭菜单并打开对话框（`lib/client.js`）。 - 技能注册表没有过滤钩子，Host 端包装了注册表的 `collectFresh`，按查询的 `cwd` 去掉禁用的技能；注册表缓存本来就按 `cwd` 区分（`lib/index.js`）。 - MCP 通过 `agent.ctx.tools.restrict({ deny })` 对每个会话屏蔽工具，工具集合或选择变化时自动重算。 - 接口：`GET /dsh-workspace-capabilities/state?workspaceId=`、`POST /dsh-workspace-capabilities/save`，走 Host 自己的请求鉴权。 ## 限制 - 依赖 DSH 0.2 内部结构（侧栏菜单 DOM、技能注册表 `collectFresh`）。DSH 升级后若这些变化，菜单项可能不出现或技能过滤失效（会在日志中警告），MCP 过滤走的是公开 API。 - 被禁用的 MCP 服务器若返回了服务器指令（instructions），该文本仍会出现在系统提示词中；只是工具不可用。 - 列表中的技能按当前工作区路径发现；只在其他 agent preset 中挂载的技能可能不显示。 - 本插件只能**隐藏**技能，不能启用在来源处被停用的技能。例如在 dsh-skills-manager 中停用的技能仍会出现在列表里，但会标为「来源已停用」且无法勾选；需先在技能管理器中重新启用。 ## 测试 ```bash npm test ```

plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 里所有未声明 reasoningEfforts 的模型自动补上 high / xhigh / max 三档的 Host 插件：零运行时依赖、无构建步骤、幂等，写入走 configEditor 正常路径并刻意放在 HMR 事务之外。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-default-reasoning-efforts

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）用的 Host 插件：
**所有没有声明推理等级的模型，自动获得 `high / xhigh / max` 三档。**

配套 [dsh-codex-effort-slider](https://github.com/Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider) 用：
滑条能不能滑到某档，取决于**模型有没有那一档**；本插件负责把缺的档位补上。

## 为什么必须改配置（而不是在界面上"造"三档）

档位不是 UI 变出来的，是 **Host 侧 LLM 适配器报出来的模型能力**：

```
profile 配置 reasoningEfforts
  → dsh-llm-pi-ai: resolveModelReasoning() → pi-ai thinkingLevelMap
  → getSupportedThinkingLevels() → reasoningInfo() → ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo()
  → 模型目录（浏览器）→ 官方菜单「推理等级」那一行 / 滑条刻度
```

配置里没写 `reasoningEfforts` 的模型，解析结果是 `reasoning: false`
（手写声明的模型不在 pi-ai 内置目录里，没有可继承的能力）。后果是双重的：

1. 模型目录里没有档位 → 官方菜单**连「推理等级」那一行都不渲染** → 滑条无处可挂；
2. 就算客户端硬塞一个档位，`dsh-llm` 在 `resolveCallWithInfo()` 里也会以
   `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT` **直接拒掉这次请求**。

所以唯一端到端成立的做法是把档位写进 provider 配置，让适配器自己认。

## 它做什么

`apply()` 里做一次**幂等、可重入**的配置补齐：

1. 等目标 entry（默认 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`）出现在 `configEditor` 里（退避重试约 30 秒）；
2. 读它的**有效配置**，找出 `providers.<route>.models[]` 里所有 `reasoningEfforts` 未声明的模型；
3. 用官方 `ctx.configEditor.edit()` 写回 profile patch
   （走 Loader 正常路径：校验 → 原子写 → 失败回滚；**YAML 注释保留**）；
4. `ctx.emit('llm/adapters-updated')` —— 已连接的浏览器会**立刻重拉模型目录**，不用刷新页面。

**幂等**：没有任何要补的模型时，一个字节都不写，也不会触发重载循环
（档位已经等于目标档位的模型会被跳过，所以第二次运行是彻底的 no-op）。

**热装即可生效**（不用等重启）：写配置这一步被刻意放在 **HMR 事务之外**执行。
原因是实测踩到的坑 —— `configEditor.edit()` 内部是 `hmr.runExclusive()`，而
`runExclusive` 一旦发现自己已经处在一次 HMR 事务里就直接拒绝
（`HMR transactions cannot be nested`）；插件热装/热启用时 `apply()` 恰好跑在
这样一次事务里，而且 hmr 用的是 `AsyncLocalStorage`，上下文会顺着 `setTimeout`
一路传下去 —— 所以"晚一点再写"根本逃不出去（第一版插件就是这么**静默失败**的）。
现在照官方 `hmr.watchConfig` 的做法用 `AsyncLocalStorage.exit()` 把写入放到事务外，
拿不到就退回普通调用；写入被拒时还会退避重试（约 37 秒），绝不静默吞掉。

## 默认规则

| 模型状态 | 默认行为 |
|---|---|
| 没写 `reasoningEfforts` | **补上 `{high: high, xhigh: xhigh, max: max}`** |
| 写了 `reasoningEfforts: false` | 不动（显式声明"这个模型没有推理"，视为用户的明确选择） |
| 写了别的档位表 | 不动 |
| 写了但恰好就是这三档 | 不动（保证幂等） |

## 可选配置

`$DSH_HOME/dsh-default-reasoning-efforts/config.json`（**不存在就用内置默认值**，改完下次检查即生效）：

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "levels": { "high": "high", "xhigh": "xhigh", "max": "max" },
  "targets": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"],
  "providers": [],
  "includeDeclared": false,
  "dryRun": false
}
```

| 键 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `enabled` | `false` = 完全不动手（插件照常加载，只跳过补齐） |
| `levels` | 要补的档位表：键只能是 pi-ai 的七档名 `off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max`，值是**线上拼写**（`off` 允许 `null` = 不发送该参数） |
| `targets` | 要管的 entry **包名**（默认只动 pi-ai 适配器；别的适配器 schema 不同，别乱加） |
| `providers` | provider route 白名单（`[]` = 全部） |
| `includeDeclared` | `true` = 连已声明（含 `false`）的模型也覆盖成 `levels` |
| `dryRun` | `true` = 只在日志里说会改什么，不写文件 |
| `pollSeconds` | **兜底自检**间隔（秒，默认 30，`0` = 关掉）。见下 |

### 新加的模型什么时候会被补上

| 时机 | 会不会补 |
|---|---|
| **每次 DSH 启动** | **一定**。启动那次检查会扫全部模型，缺档位的一个不落 |
| 运行中在**设置页新增模型** | **会**，最多 `pollSeconds`（默认 30 秒）内 |
| 运行中**手改 `cordis.patch.yml` 文件** | 要等下次启动（实测：这个环境里 HMR 的配置监视没把文件改动送进运行中的 Loader；反正下次启动会补） |
| 插件被禁用（`enabled: false`） | 不补 |

为什么要有 `pollSeconds` 这个自检：宿主确实会发 `llm/adapters-updated` /
`settings/document-updated` / `hmr/reload` 这几个事件（插件都订阅了），
但"事件有没有送达"不在本插件的控制范围内 —— 与其把正确性押在上面，
不如按固定间隔自己看一眼：有活就干，没活就是一次纯读的 no-op。
30 秒一次的读取成本可以忽略，换来的是"新加的模型一定会被补上"这个确定性。

配置非法时会退回内置默认值并在日志里说明原因（不静默）。

## 回执：它到底做了什么

每次检查的结论会写到 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-default-reasoning-efforts/status.json`
（只在结果变化时写，不是每次事件都动磁盘）：

```json
{
  "at": "2026-10-14T01:41:46.342Z",
  "pid": 23388,
  "enabled": true,
  "targets": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"],
  "levels": { "high": "high", "xhigh": "xhigh", "max": "max" },
  "status": "patched",
  "matchedEntries": ["llm-pi-ai"],
  "changedModels": [{ "provider": "local", "model": "step-5-preview", "levels": { "high": "high", "xhigh": "xhigh", "max": "max" } }],
  "wrote": true,
  "error": null
}
```

`status` 取值：`patched`（补了）/ `no-change`（没活可干）/ `dry-run` / `waiting-entry`
（目标 entry 还没出现）/ `read-failed` / `write-failed` / `crashed` / `disabled`。
**排障第一步就是看这个文件** —— 它比宿主日志好找，也比"猜插件跑没跑"可靠。

## 安装

```powershell
# 面板：设置 → 插件 → 添加插件 → 填仓库地址或本目录绝对路径
# 或命令行（非 desktop profile）：
dsh plugin --profile web add github:junjundesk/dsh-default-reasoning-efforts
# 本地开发时直接链本目录：
dsh plugin --profile web add link:"<本目录的绝对路径>"
```

零运行时依赖、无构建步骤（只用 node 内置模块），解开就能装。

## 测试

```powershell
node test/plan.test.mjs      # 43 项断言：档位规范化 / 配置规范化 / 补齐规划 / HMR 事务逃逸 / 端到端接线
```

测试里有一份**假 `configEditor`**：`edit()` 会把新配置落到 entry 上，所以"第二次运行必须
一个字节都不写"这件事是被真断言守着的，而不是靠肉眼。其中一项是**回归测试**：用真的
`AsyncLocalStorage` 模拟 hmr 的事务上下文，并让 `edit()` 在事务内直接抛
`HMR transactions cannot be nested` —— 它复现了第一版插件的真实故障，也守着修复不被改回去。

## 已知边界

- 只改 `providers.*.models[].reasoningEfforts` 这一个字段，其它字段原样保留。
- 补的是**声明**，不是"让模型真的会思考"：端点是否接受 `xhigh`/`max` 由上游决定，
  与你在同一个 provider 里给别的模型写的那套拼写保持一致。
- `targets` 默认只含 pi-ai 适配器。别的适配器（如官方 DeepSeek）有自己的固定档位表，
  强行补档位可能让请求被上游拒掉。
- 卸载/关掉后，已经写进 profile patch 的 `reasoningEfforts` **不会自动删掉**
  （那是你的配置，插件不替你回滚）——想恢复就把那几行删掉。

## 许可

MIT。

plugins.description: Draft, lay out, and deliver editable Word documents with a reopened-file check.
plugins.readme_text:
# WordCraft Use

## Plugin marketplaces

This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full-stack development | [Full Stack Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-plugins) | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, quality checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![WordCraft Use — editable business documents](assets/official-logo.png)

> Draft, lay out, and deliver editable Word documents from an agent session, with real section structures, native tables, and a reopened-file check before handoff.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261019.1-1A73E8)](#positioning)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-16-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP servers](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20servers-1-6E56CF)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Skills](#skills) · [MCP tools](#mcp-tools) · [Limits](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

`wordcraft` turns source material into an editable document rather than a text dump: it collects the real facts, fills a section and field structure, lays the result out with native headings, tables, page numbers, and headers, then reopens the file and checks what the reader will actually see. It wraps the native WordCraft engine in sixteen skills and one embedded editor.

This is an installable development candidate. Production promotion is blocked, embedded host synchronization is not accepted, and short one-page samples do not prove that arbitrary long documents paginate correctly.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Plugin ID | `wordcraft` |
| Display name | WordCraft Use |
| Version | `0.1.0-dev.20261018.5` |
| Stage | Installable development candidate, production promotion blocked |
| Native engine | WordCraft 0.7.0 via `wordcraft-cli` |
| Marketplace | `wordcraft-marketplace` |
| License | Apache-2.0 |

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Codex is the host with recorded evidence. Other hosts are not accepted.
- Node.js 24 or newer is required by the embedded editor. The distributed package already contains the editor build; no Rust toolchain and no `npm install` are needed at runtime.
- Native file workflows use `wordcraft-cli`, which this plugin does not install. Query the installed version and command schema before running a recipe.
- The first Git-based launch needs network access or an existing verified editor cache. Complete release ZIPs can start offline from bundled assets.
- Windows Git installs need long-path support: `git config --global core.longpaths true`.

### From the plugin marketplace

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins
codex plugin add wordcraft@full-aigc-plugins
```

The repository also ships its own marketplace metadata (`wordcraft-marketplace`) pinned to `v0.1.0-dev.20261018.5`. Restart the host, open a new task, and state the document type and the real source material.

## Quick start

1. Say what to produce and from what: “Write this week's report from these work notes; mark anything missing as pending confirmation.”
2. Let the agent choose the document skill and fill real fields. Templates describe sections, required fields, and native layout operations; they are not empty outlines with a new title.
3. Ask for a new editable DOCX plus a review PDF. Templates are designed for new documents, not for overwriting an existing file.
4. Reopen the DOCX, check heading levels, cell-by-cell table content, and column counts, then compare against the PDF page.

```text
Meeting minutes: turn these notes into minutes with decisions and action items.
Weekly report: summarize progress, blockers, and next week's plan.
Proposal: produce a project proposal with phases, deliverables, and owners.
Quotation: build a line-item table with quantities and decimal prices; do not infer tax.
```

Direct CLI form for file tasks, one method per argv argument; verify text afterwards with `wordcraft-cli text out.docx`:

```bash
wordcraft-cli run --cmd 'text.insert={"text":"Body text"}' --save out.docx
```

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Meeting minutes | `wordcraft-meeting-minutes` | Decisions, owners, and action items in an editable table |
| Weekly report | `wordcraft-weekly-report` | Completed, in-progress, blocked, and next-step sections kept separate |
| Project proposal | `wordcraft-business-proposal` | Goals, phases, deliverables, and planned dates |
| Requirements document | `wordcraft-requirements-document` | Numbered requirements with observable acceptance conditions |
| Acceptance report | `wordcraft-acceptance-report` | Expected versus actual results, with failed items preserved |
| Business letter | `wordcraft-business-letter` | Recipient, subject, confirmed facts, and requested reply |
| Commercial quotation | `wordcraft-quotation` | Native line-item table, per-line amounts, and a checked total |
| Research and resume layout | `wordcraft-research-report`, `wordcraft-resume-layout` | Structured sections, figures, references, and a compact layout |
| Long-form structure | `wordcraft-toc-handbook`, `wordcraft-illustrated-guide`, `wordcraft-landscape-appendix` | Updatable table of contents, captioned figures, and portrait body with landscape appendix |
| Revision and playbooks | `wordcraft-document-comparison`, `wordcraft-document-style`, `wordcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Text and structure diff, unified styles, eight checked recipes |

## Skills

### Document templates

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-meeting-minutes` | Build minutes from discussion, decisions, and action items |
| `wordcraft-weekly-report` | Build a weekly report from work records, progress, and next-week plans |
| `wordcraft-business-proposal` | Build a proposal with goals, approach, plan, and delivery |
| `wordcraft-requirements-document` | Turn interviews or drafts into numbered, testable requirements |
| `wordcraft-acceptance-report` | Record acceptance criteria, measured results, and open issues |
| `wordcraft-business-letter` | Draft a business letter from recipient, subject, and confirmed facts |

### Commercial and layout

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-quotation` | Compile explicit line items into a native table and verify decimal totals |
| `wordcraft-research-report` | Lay out abstract, sections, figures, tables, and references |
| `wordcraft-resume-layout` | Lay out experience and outcomes in a compact resume |
| `wordcraft-document-style` | Unify headings, paragraphs, lists, and tables across a document |

### Long-form and comparison

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-toc-handbook` | Produce a handbook with an updatable table of contents |
| `wordcraft-illustrated-guide` | Produce a guide with images and captions |
| `wordcraft-landscape-appendix` | Combine a portrait body with a landscape matrix appendix |
| `wordcraft-document-comparison` | Compare two versions for textual and structural differences |

### Session and playbooks

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-editor` | Open the real editor in an MCP Apps host or host browser and share one workspace session |
| `wordcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Eight recipes for project briefs, SOPs, release notes, decision tables, letters, training decks, and two-column briefs |

## MCP tools

`.codex-plugin/mcp.json` starts one stdio server, `wordcraft-editor`, from `ui/bootstrap.mjs`. The adapter adds three stable tools and passes through the pinned engine's document tool catalog.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `open_editor` | Open the editor for an absolute `workspace`; the first call binds the workspace |
| `open_browser_editor` | Return an `editorUrl` for the same session when the host has a built-in browser |
| `editor_status` | Report whether the editor actually attached and is ready

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 工具插件：一句「帮我生成本周周报」即得固定四模块 Markdown 周报；内置流水线，装上即用。
plugins.readme_text:
# mimetics-dsh-weekly-report

> **装上后，在 Harness 对话框说一句「帮我生成本周周报」，就能拿到固定四模块的 Markdown 周报**
> （〖本周完成〗〖进行中〗〖风险与阻塞〗〖下周计划〗）——由 `generate_weekly_report` 工具驱动内置流水线生成。

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/mimetics-ai/mimetics-dsh-weekly-report)

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/mimetics-dsh-weekly-report.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mimetics-dsh-weekly-report)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add mimetics-dsh-weekly-report
```

从 GitHub 直装（等价写法）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mimetics-ai/mimetics-dsh-weekly-report
```

安装后**重启 `dsh web`**，然后在对话框里直接说：

> 帮我生成本周周报，素材是：本周把登录页崩溃修完了，数据看板还在联调……

**验证已挂载**（二选一）：

1. **设置 → 插件**：应能看到 `mimetics-dsh-weekly-report`；
2. 打开调试日志（安装后设置环境变量 `WEEKLY_REPORT_DEBUG=1` 再启动 `dsh web`），启动日志会打印：

```
[weekly-report] generate_weekly_report 已注册 | plugin v1.3.0 | pipeline v1.1.2 | projectRoot=… | python=…
```

---

## 它做什么

- **把散素材收成一份周报**：工作记录 / 聊天摘录 / Jira 工单 / Excel 表 / 会议纪要 / 日志，可混着给；
- **合并同类项**：同一件事在不同来源出现多次时合并为一条，并在诊断里说明合并依据；
- **区分状态**：自动分到〖本周完成〗〖进行中〗〖风险与阻塞〗〖下周计划〗四个固定模块；
- **冲突不擅自取舍**：跨来源状态矛盾、或同一对象报了不同数值时，**归入〖风险与阻塞〗并写明冲突点**；
- **绝不编造**：数值/日期一律取自素材原文；缺数据的条目不做估算，只在诊断里提示。

## 工具入参

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `materials` | `string[]` | ✅ | 素材列表。每项可以是**文件绝对路径**（`.md`/`.txt`/`.csv`/`.xlsx`），也可以是**素材原文文本**，两者可混用 |
| `outPath` | `string` | ✖ | 额外输出路径，把 Markdown 另存一份（目录自动创建） |

## 输出示例

```markdown
〖本周完成〗
- 修复登录页在 iOS 上的崩溃问题，回归通过
- 数据看板优化，覆盖 3 个核心指标
〖进行中〗
- 对账模块重构，已提测
〖风险与阻塞〗
- ⚠️ 数值冲突：跨素材数值不一致（3 条规则 / 5 条规则），完成风控规则配置，覆盖 3 条规则
〖下周计划〗
- 待确认
```

---

## 权限与风险（Clear risk）

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **运行依赖** | 本机需有 **Python 3.9+**（实测 3.13 / 3.15）。插件通过 `execFile` 调用 Python 运行内置流水线；未找到解释器时会给出明确的配置指引 |
| **文件读写** | 只读写**包内流水线目录**与插件自己的临时目录；若你在配置里显式给出 `projectRoot`，则读写该目录下的 `src/`、`config/` |
| **网络** | **无任何网络请求**；不上传素材、不调用外部服务、无遥测 |
| **数据** | 素材只在本地进程间传递，产出物由你自行决定保存位置 |
| **权限** | 仅注册一个工具 `generate_weekly_report`，不申请额外系统权限、不执行生命周期脚本 |

## 配置

在 profile 的插件配置里可覆盖（一般无需配置，装上即用）：

| 配置键 | 环境变量 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pythonPath` | `WEEKLY_REPORT_PYTHON` | 依次探测 PATH 上的 `python` / `python3` / `py` | Python 解释器：绝对路径或命令名 |
| `projectRoot` | `WEEKLY_REPORT_PROJECT_ROOT` | **包内 `pipeline/` 目录** | 流水线根目录（含 `src/pipeline.py` 与 `pipeline/config/config.json`） |
| `timeoutMs` | — | `120000` | 单次调用超时 |
| — | `WEEKLY_REPORT_DEBUG` | 未设置 | 设为 `1` 打印挂载与版本日志 |

## 兼容性

- **DSH**：`0.2.0-rc.2` 实测通过。peer 依赖：`@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.4`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools 0.2.0-rc.2`。
  ⚠️ DSH 处于开发者预览，官方明确会有破坏性变更；**升级 dsh 后请核对本段与包的版本**。
- **Node**：`>= 20.11`（实测 22.x）。
- **平台**：Windows 实测；macOS / Linux 未验证（代码不依赖平台专有 API，理论上可用）。
- **Python**：3.9+；仅用标准库，不需要 `pip install` 任何东西。

## 排障

| 现象 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 启动日志没有 `[weekly-report]` | 确认已安装且 `WEEKLY_REPORT_DEBUG=1`；用 `dsh plugin --profile web list` 核对 |
| `未找到可用的 Python 解释器` | 显式配置 `pythonPath`，或设置 `WEEKLY_REPORT_PYTHON` |
| `未找到周报流水线入口` | 你的 `projectRoot` 配置指向了不含 `src/pipeline.py` 的目录；清掉该配置即回落到包内流水线 |
| 报 `素材文件不存在` | 这是**预期行为**：路径类入参若不存在会直接失败，而不是把路径当文本产出一份假周报 |
| 中文输出乱码 | 不应出现（插件强制 `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8`） |

---

## 开发

见 [`docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`](./docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)（本地加载方式、源码结构、构建与自测）。

## 许可与声明

- **许可证**：[MIT](./LICENSE)
- **主体**：广州永摹纪智能科技有限公司
- **声明**：本项目是**社区插件**，非 DeepSeek 官方项目；遵循 DeepSeek Harness 插件规范
  （导出 `apply(ctx)`，通过 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明 bundle）。问题请在本仓库提 issue。

plugins.description: Bottom-right native Windows cards for DeepSeek Harness: approve a permission request, know a question is waiting, and get a summary when a turn finishes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-desk-card

Bottom-right native desktop cards for **DSH (DeepSeek Harness)** approvals, questions, turn
completion and errors.

Each card is a small always-on-top window drawn by PowerShell/WPF — not a system toast — so it
can carry a button that answers the request. An approval can be allowed straight from the card,
and the moment a card would interrupt something else (a fullscreen app, a game, Do-Not-Disturb)
it is skipped and the decision goes back to the normal DSH UI.

Windows only. No dependencies, no network, no build step.

## Why not just a toast

| | system toast | this card |
|---|---|---|
| carries a button that returns an answer | depends on the shell / extra runtime | yes, the card's own button |
| can allow an approval in place | no (toasts only focus the app) | yes — `确认允许` / `Allow` |
| respects fullscreen games and Do-Not-Disturb | only if the OS suppresses it | explicit gate, checked before the window is drawn |
| UI language | whatever the OS shows | follows the DSH locale, or forced with `language` |

## Screenshots

![approval card](assets/approval-zh.png)

![completion card](assets/done-zh.png)

![error card](assets/error-en.png)

![two cards stacked](assets/stacked-zh.png)

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11 (cards are drawn with `powershell.exe` + WPF, which ship with Windows).
- DSH desktop profile (the cards are injected by the **host** process, no browser side needed).
- Node.js 20+ (whatever DSH ships is fine).

## Install

From this repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:nanshang328/dsh-desk-card
```

Or from a local clone / download:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-desk-card
```

Then restart DSH. The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so the CLI records it in
`dsh.profile.bundles` and mounts it as a normal profile layer — no hand-written paths.

Windows developer helper: `powershell.exe -File tools/deploy-local.ps1` copies the working tree
into `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\plugins\dsh-desk-card` and registers it the same way.

## What shows up

| card | when | auto-close | buttons |
|---|---|---|---|
| Approval | a tool call needs permission | never (waits for you) | `确认允许` / `Allow` approves once · clicking the card opens DSH for the full dialog |
| Question | the agent asks you something | never, closes when the question is answered | `知道了` / `Got it` |
| Completion | a turn ends normally | `doneTimeoutSeconds` (default 5s) | `知晓` / `OK` |
| Error | a turn fails | never | `知道了` / `Got it` |

The completion card also carries a short summary of your last message, the elapsed time, the
remaining todo count and the turn/session token usage.

Cards never overlap: a new card stacks above the ones already on screen. If the DSH window is
closed while a card is open, the card closes itself too.

## Configuration

Everything has a built-in default, so this section is optional. To change something, add a row
with the same id from your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-desk-card
      name: dsh-desk-card
      config:
        doneTimeoutSeconds: 10
        scale: 1.0
        language: en
```

Only the keys you list are changed — a `config` object replaces the whole object, and every key
you leave out falls back to the defaults below.

| key | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `timeoutSeconds` | `0` | auto-close seconds for cards that wait for **you** (approval / question). `0` = stay until answered |
| `doneTimeoutSeconds` | `5` | auto-close seconds for the completion card. `0` = keep it until clicked |
| `scale` | `1.2` | card scale factor |
| `skipWhenFullscreen` | `true` | skip cards while a fullscreen app is in the foreground, or while Windows says Do-Not-Disturb |
| `notifyQuestions` | `true` | show the question card |
| `notifyErrors` | `true` | show the error card |
| `notifyDone` | `true` | show the completion card |
| `language` | `auto` | `auto` (follow the DSH locale), `zh` or `en` |
| `hostProcess` | `DeepSeek Harness` | the process whose window is brought to front when you click a card |

The three `notify*` switches only control the cards — approvals and questions always keep
working, the card just does not appear.

### The fullscreen gate

A card is not drawn when either of these is true:

- `SHQueryUserNotificationState` reports a fullscreen app, presentation mode or Do-Not-Disturb; or
- the foreground window covers its whole monitor and is not the desktop (this keeps games that
  hide the real state from being interrupted).

When a card is skipped the approval is handed back to the normal DSH UI (with `prepend: true`
this plugin speaks first, and a skipped card always delegates to the next answerer), so nothing
gets stuck. Two test tools reproduce the condition without a game:

```powershell
powershell.exe -File test/gate-probe.ps1 -MaxSeconds 20          # watch the gate flip blocked -> free
powershell.exe -File test/fake-fullscreen.ps1 -HoldSeconds 8     # paint a fullscreen window for 8s
```

## How it works

```
lib/index.js      host half: listens to approval/request, user-questions/request,
                  agent/error, agent/status; spawns one card per event and maps the
                  card's exit code back to an approval outcome.
scripts/card.ps1  render half: one PowerShell process per card. Runs the gate, draws the
                  WPF window, stacks it above sibling cards, runs timers, then exits with
                  a code that the host half reads.
```

Exit-code protocol between the two halves:

| code | meaning |
|---|---|
| `10` | the card's primary button was pressed |
| `12` | the card body was clicked — bring the DSH window to the front, let the UI decide |
| `0` | gate skipped the card (fullscreen / Do-Not-Disturb) |
| `3` | rendering failed |

Being one process per card keeps the render half stateless: a card can never wedge the host,
and a card that is killed by the OS just delegates the decision.

## Logs and troubleshooting

`%TEMP%\dsh-desk-card.log` records card placement, exit codes, config and gate decisions:

```
apply() started config={"skipWhenFullscreen":true,...}
showCard[approval]: exit 10
approval resolved: allowed-once
done card (41234ms, autoClose=5s)
```

Cards are spawned without a console window. If no card ever appears, check in order: a
fullscreen app is holding the gate (`-SkipWhenFullscreen false` for a manual test), PowerShell
is blocked by policy for the DSH process, and finally the log file.

Manual card render (bypasses the host half entirely):

```powershell
$payload = [Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('{"badge":"test","head":"hello","body":"line","okLabel":"OK","okCode":10}'))
powershell.exe -File scripts/card.ps1 -Payload $payload -TimeoutSeconds 5 -Scale 1.2 -SkipWhenFullscreen false -DebugLog "$env:TEMP\card-test.log"
```

## Limitations

- Windows only. The render half is PowerShell + WPF; there is no macOS/Linux path.
- Cards are ordinary top-level windows, so they appear above other windows but not above a
  fullscreen exclusive game — which is why the gate exists.
- One PowerShell process per card (about 100 ms of warm-up). A card is not a notification
  center entry: once it is closed it is gone.
- This plugin deliberately does **not** restart or shut down DSH. If you want power controls,
  [dsh-power-button](https://github.com/keyiadiannao/dsh-power-button) and
  [dsh-restart](https://github.com/anweat/dsh-restart) do that well.

## Privacy

The host half never opens a socket and never reads a file. It spawns one local PowerShell
process per card and appends a line to `%TEMP%\dsh-desk-card.log`. Card payloads contain short
excerpts of your session (task title, tool name, approval reason, error message) and are passed
to that child process as a command-line argument.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Sidebar tab listing running and completed-unread sessions across projects, with click-to-switch and grouping.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-active-sessions

左侧边栏「进行中」tab：跨项目平铺展示会话，点击即切换。

分组顺序（自上而下）：
1. **进行中** —— 运行中，或等待审批/计划审阅/回答的会话；
2. **已完成** —— 已停止但尚未读过（打开即清除未读）的会话；
3. **近 12h 活跃** —— 其余空闲会话，默认折叠（展开态记在 localStorage）。

tab 角标 = 进行中 + 已完成未读的数量，不含折叠的空闲会话。

由 dsh-super-injector dev_scaffold_plugin 生成。

## 构建与注入

```bash
bash scripts/build.sh
# 注入器环境内：dev_inject_plugin <本目录>
```

plugins.description: dsh-icon-switch: in-app icon switcher for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-icon-switch

In-app icon switcher for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Change the app / tray / taskbar icon right from the Settings page, upload any image to generate a full icon set, round the corners, and optionally hide the sidebar brand row.

## Features

- **Icon gallery** — preview every installed icon set inside the DSH Settings page.
- **Upload → icon set** — upload a PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP and the bundled PowerShell engine generates the full set (`app-icon.png/.ico` + tray sizes).
- **Rounded corners** — optional 26% corner radius; the square original is kept as `source.png` so toggling it off restores sharp corners.
- **Tray & taskbar** — writes `tray.ico`/`icon.png` for the app, updates Windows shortcuts, and sets the taskbar icon (Electron `setIcon` first, a resident PowerShell watcher as fallback).
- **Hide sidebar brand row** — optional pure-CSS toggle, instant.

## Install

```
dsh plugin add dsh-icon-switch
```

or from source:

```
dsh plugin add github:yturjzw/dsh-icon-switch
```

After installing, **fully quit and restart DSH** so the plugin loads and the tray icon is picked up.

## How it works

`lib/index.js` registers a settings section plus loopback-only HTTP routes under
`/api/dsh-icon-switch/`. The bundled `tool/dsh-icon-switch.ps1` engine reads and
writes icon sets under `tool/icons` (override the directory with the `toolDir`
setting if you want them to persist across plugin reinstalls).

## Layout

```
lib/index.js          host side: Config schema, routes, engine spawn
client/client.js      browser settings section (gallery, upload, form)
tool/                 bundled PowerShell engines + starter icon sets
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch
```

## Icon files

- `tray.ico` → `process.resourcesPath\tray.ico` (tray icon, read once at startup).
- `icon.png` → `process.resourcesPath\icon.png` (About panel; the window/taskbar icon is set via `setIcon`/WM_SETICON at runtime).
- ICO frames are built as 32 bpp DIB with an alpha-derived AND mask — PNG frames are rejected by some shell extraction paths and show up as a blank icon.

# dsh-session-handoff

**会话自动衔接**：新建会话时，自动把「上一场会话」的尾部对话注入为一段交接材料，使新会话不必从头解释上下文。 ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**（在目标 profile 的 `package.json` 加 link 依赖）： ```jsonc "dsh-session-handoff": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-session-handoff" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: dsh-session-handoff name: dsh-session-handoff ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：新建会话 → 首轮上下文里应出现上一场的**尾部对话**（仅在存在新鲜对话时注入） ## 解决的问题 一场会话卡住/中断/上下文过载后，新开一场就丢失了「刚在做什么、卡在哪、下一步是什么」。手工复述既费时又容易漏。本插件把这件事变成自动的、可核查的一行注入。 ## 它做什么 - 监听 `session/created`（`{ global: true }`），只对**真正的新会话**生效：子代理会话、fork 子会话、重启时恢复的历史会话一律跳过。 - 取该会话的 **scope key**（`carrierKeyOf(this)`——事件的 `this` 是 routing-only 载体，没有 Context API），找到同工作目录、窗口内最近的一场有真实对话的会话。 - 摘录它**尾部的若干条 user/assistant 文本**（不调模型、不做摘要生成，成本为 0 且可复现），渲染成一段交接块。 - 交接块经 `systemPrompt.context` 落为**动态上下文快照**：全局注册一次，`text` 按本次装配的 `AssembleContext.scope` 查表返回——未命中的会话拿到空串，而「空文本不贡献任何内容」是 `PromptContext` 的既定语义 ⇒ 只影响被衔接的那一场会话。 交接块首行显式声明**它是历史材料、不是新指令**——衔接内容来自上一场会话，绝不能变成可执行的命令。 ## 它不做什么 | 不做 | 归属 | |---|---| | fork（全量继承历史） | `sessions.fork` | | 生成式摘要（调模型压缩） | 模型侧 or 人工 | | 改系统提示词 / 工具面 | `section` / 工具注册 | | 跨会话记忆 | `dsh-agent-memory` | ## 配置 | 字段 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 | | `maxAgeMinutes` | `720` | 新鲜度窗口：上一场会话最后活动早于此则不衔接 | | `maxChars` | `3000` | 交接块字符预算 | | `messageChars` | `400` | 单条消息字符上限 | | `maxMessages` | `8` | 最多引用多少条消息 | | `sameWorkspaceOnly` | `true` | 只衔接同一工作目录的会话 | | `maxCandidates` | `3` | 最多向前探查几个候选（每个都要读日志，故设上限） | | `order` | `850` | 动态上下文排序位 | ## 观测（机制自证） 每次注入/跳过/出错都落一行侧车： ```sh tail -f "$DSH_HOME/session-handoff-trace.jsonl" ``` `stage` 取值：`injected`（注入成功，带来源会话/字符数/消息数）、`skip`（无合格对话）、`filtered`（被判据跳过，带 `reason`）、`error` / `candidate-error`（读日志失败）。 判据（可证伪）：开一场新会话后，该文件应出现一行 `"stage":"injected"`，且其中的 `session` 等于新会话 id；未产生注入时会看到 `filtered`/`skip` 并附原因——**不会静默什么都不写**。 ## 已知边界 - **不作为的注入**：交接文本进入模型历史（动态上下文快照默认进历史），因此只摘录 user/assistant 文本，不摘录工具结果与文件内容。 - **只认「最近一场」**：不跨多场会话合并，不猜测话题相关性；判据是时间 + 工作目录，不含语义相似度。 - **读日志有成本**：候选逐个 `observeSession`（读完整事件流）。`maxCandidates` 就是这个成本的闸门；`projectionMode: 'none'` 已关闭投影计算。 - **`sessionQuery` 是硬依赖**：写在 `inject` 里（不是 `ctx.get()` 探测）。用探测会与加载顺序赛跑，失败时插件静默变成空转（实测：装了、mounted、却零轨迹）。 - **「新会话」按内容判，不按创建时间判**：判据是该会话自身还没有真实对话（见下「实践修订记录」）。 ## 测试 ```sh pnpm build && pnpm test # 10 个用例，含 4 条尸体样本（子代理/fork/过期/无对话/异目录/自身） ``` 纯决策层（`src/handoff.ts`）与 IO 壳层（`src/index.ts`）分层：判据与渲染可离线验证，壳层只做搬运。 ## 实践修订记录 两处判据都是被真实运行打回来才改对的，留档以免重犯： 1. **2026-09-30 · `ctx.get('sessionQuery')` 探测 → 静态 `inject`** 首版用 `ctx.get()` 探测服务，探测失败就打一条 warn 后返回。结果：插件 `mounted`、`built: true`、进程也重启了，**却零轨迹**——外部完全看不出「没加载」与「加载了但空转」的区别。改为 `inject = ['systemPrompt', 'sessionQuery']` 声明式依赖，并加一行启动自报 `stage: 'ready'`。教训：**机制必须自证**，否则「装了」和「在工作」在观测上是同一张脸。 2. **2026-09-30 · 按 `createdAt` 判「新会话」 → 按「自身有无真实对话」判** 首版用「创建时间在 N 分钟内」识别新会话。实测：GUI 点「新会话」复用的是既有空白会话的 id（21:28 建的空会话，22:05 点「新会话」时仍用它），于是被误判为「恢复的老会话」而拒绝注入（轨迹里留下 `"reason":"not-new"`）。改为内容判据：`extractMessages(session.snapshotEvents()).length === 0` 才算新会话。**判据要贴语义（「还没有对话」），不要贴代理量（「创建时间新」）。** ## 相关文档 - ⚠ **本插件暂无 `semantic.md`**（未建语义文档）——契约以 README 各节与源码为准；补文档是待办。 - 中心仓：[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life)

plugins.description: Author, inspect, and export editable presentation decks one slide at a time.
plugins.readme_text:
# DeckCraft Use

## Plugin marketplaces

This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full-stack development | [Full Stack Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-plugins) | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, quality checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![DeckCraft Use — editable presentations from a coding agent](assets/official-logo.png)

> Author, inspect and export a real presentation from your agent host — one slide at a time, with the editable source deck kept as the deliverable.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261019.1-1A73E8)](https://github.com/full-aigc-plugins/deckcraft-plugin/releases)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-10-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20tools-33-00A67E)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Skills](#skills) · [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

`deckcraft` lets an agent host drive the DeckCraft engine through a bundled stdio MCP server and a set of presentation skills, so a request ends with an editable `.deckcraft` deck plus the exports you asked for. The plugin owns skill routing, the same-session editor bridge and package pinning. It does not replace DeckCraft, its engine, or the host runtime.

| Property | Value |
| :--- | :--- |
| Plugin ID | `deckcraft` |
| Version | `0.1.0-dev.20261018.4` |
| Status | Development preview; production promotion blocked, all-host acceptance open |
| Editor runtime | Node.js 24, started from `ui/bootstrap.mjs` |
| Upstream reference | DeckCraft `0.3.0` (`d0e57d7e25f9852179cc66be12dd6188f1c05535`) |
| Optional CLI | `deckcraft-cli`, if your host already has it on `PATH` |
| License | Apache-2.0 |

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 24 on `PATH`; the bundled stdio MCP server runs on it.
- Network access on the first editor launch. The plugin downloads and verifies the pinned editor archive; a complete release ZIP already contains it, so no Rust toolchain and no `npm install` are required.
- A `deckcraft-cli` installation only if you want the native CLI path. The plugin never installs or upgrades it.
- A host that supports plugins or stdio MCP. Embedded panels additionally require MCP Apps or a built-in browser.

### From the plugin marketplace

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins
codex plugin add deckcraft@full-aigc-plugins
```

Restart the host, open a new task, and ask DeckCraft to start a deck.

### Other host manifests

| Host | Manifest | Path base |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Agent Plugins 1.0.0 | `plugin.json`, `mcp.json` | `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` |
| Codex | `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, `.codex-plugin/mcp.json` | plugin root relative to `cwd` |
| Claude Code | `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.mcp.json` | `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` |

Kimi (`kimi.plugin.json`), DeepSeek Harness (`dsh/`) and the WorkBuddy example (`hosts/workbuddy/mcp.json`) are also present. `hosts/native-cli/mcp.json` shows the optional `deckcraft-cli mcp` server instead of the bundled editor.

## Quick start

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Install plugin] --> B[Restart and open a task]
    B --> C[open_editor]
    C --> D{editor_status ready?}
    D -->|No| C
    D -->|Yes| E[new_presentation]
    E --> F[add_slide / add_shape / insert_chart]
    F --> G[inspect_slide]
    G --> H[save_presentation / export]
```

1. Open the editor with an explicit `workspace` argument.
2. Start a deck with `new_presentation`, or open an existing one with `open_presentation`.
3. Read `list_commands` before complex edits; command IDs and `enabled` state come from the live registry.
4. After each block of edits, call `inspect_document` or `inspect_slide`, and `render_slide` when you need a picture.
5. Save the `.deckcraft` source, then export. Reopen the source to confirm the slides are still editable.

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Pitch deck with problem, evidence and ask | `deckcraft-pitch-deck` | Slide-per-message deck with speaker notes |
| Weekly or status report | `deckcraft-weekly-report` | Progress, risk and next-step slides |
| Training courseware | `deckcraft-training-slides` | Explanation, example, exercise and recap slides |
| Data narrative | `deckcraft-data-story` + `insert_chart` | Chart bound to your data with title and labels |
| Brand template reuse | `deckcraft-brand-template` | Master-styled slides, consistent layouts |
| Redesign an existing deck | `deckcraft-slide-redesign` | Restructured deck, original retained |
| Option comparison | `deckcraft-option-comparison` + `insert_table` | Editable comparison table with units and sources |
| Delivery | `save_presentation`, `export` | Editable source plus PPTX, PDF or image output |

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
| :--- | :--- |
| `deckcraft-use` | Main entry: create, modify, inspect or export a deck through the connected MCP or an installed CLI |
| `deckcraft-editor` | Open the real editor in the host and keep agent edits on the same page |
| `deckcraft-pitch-deck` | Problem, solution, evidence and ask for a project pitch |
| `deckcraft-weekly-report` | Progress, issues, metrics and next-week plan |
| `deckcraft-training-slides` | Explanation, examples, exercises and recap |
| `deckcraft-data-story` | Data conclusion and business interpretation, with chart plans |
| `deckcraft-brand-template` | Master style and recurring layouts for a brand |
| `deckcraft-slide-redesign` | Restructure and visually improve an existing deck |
| `deckcraft-option-comparison` | Cost, lead time and risk compared in an editable table |
| `deckcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Step-by-step recipes for metric briefing, comparison, flow, risk matrix, trend, training Q&A and handoff |

Skills come from the independent `deckcraft-skills` source and are pinned by `scenario-candidates.json` with per-skill SHA-256 digests. They carry scenario knowledge and execution contracts, not a second engine.

## MCP tools

One bundled server, `deckcraft-editor`, speaking **stdio**. The local HTTP listener only serves the editor page and its same-session bridge. The catalogue exposes 33 tools: 28 agent-callable tools and 5 `_editor_*` bridge tools the panel uses internally.

| Family | Tools | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Session | `open_editor`, `open_browser_editor`, `editor_status` | Open the editor and confirm that it attached |
| Discovery | `list_commands`, `call_app` | List live commands; `call_app` reaches app-level control methods (desktop app only) |
| Command gateway | `run_command`, `batch` | Run one command, or an ordered batch with explicit failure semantics |
| Deck management | `new_presentation`, `open_presentation`, `save_presentation`, `export` | Create, open, save and export |
| Slides | `add_slide`, `go_to_slide`, `inspect_slide`, `render_slide` | Add, navigate, read and render one slide |
| Content | `add_shape`, `add_text_box`, `set_text`, `insert_picture`, `insert_table`, `insert_chart` | Place and edit the objects a slide is made of |
| Inspection | `inspect_document` | Titles, page count, objects and text of the whole deck |
| Interaction | `select`, `select_tool`, `pointer`, `key`, `type_text`, `screenshot` | Drive the same paths a mouse and keyboard would; `screenshot` captures the whole window and needs the desktop app |

## Configuration

| Setting | Where | Effect |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `workspace` argument | `open_editor` / `open_browser_editor` | Binds the task folder; paths outside it are refused |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_UPDATE=off` | stdio MCP `env` | Use the bundled editor only; no download attempt |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_CACHE_DIR` | Environment | Absolute directory for verified editor archives |
| `CRAFT_WORKSPACE_ROOT` | Host MCP conf

plugins.description: DSH plugin: permanent Delete-session action for the session menu (DSH only ships archive)
plugins.readme_text:
# @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-session-delete

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

Adds a **Delete session** action to the session "…" menu of DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` only ships **archive** (a soft delete: hidden, but all data is kept). This plugin fills the gap — one click **permanently deletes** a session together with its on-disk data.

## Features

- In the session row's "…" menu, right after the built-in Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive, a new **Delete session** entry appears.
- Clicking it opens a confirmation dialog (showing the session title); confirming invokes the host-side delete.
- Deleting cleans up three data locations:
  1. The session itself: `~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/<session-id>/`
  2. The projection cache: `~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<session-id>.json`
  3. The session's registration in the workspace index (`sessionIds` / archive / pin marks)
- After a successful delete, the open UI **needs no refresh** — the row disappears via the `api-session/removed` event.
- **Auto-repairs the default workspace**: DSH's built-in "Delete workspace", if it ever deleted the default one, leaves dangling pointers — its sessions fall into "Ungrouped" and new sessions can no longer be created. On startup this plugin rebuilds the registration and re-homes the sessions **for the default workspace only** (identified via `defaultWorkspaceId` or the last remembered path). Other workspaces you deleted on purpose are not "revived".

## Safety

- **Running sessions refuse deletion**: it uses the same `workspace/session-activity` detection as DSH's archive. Only genuinely running work (an in-flight conversation turn, background jobs, …) is blocked with "this session is running"; idle old sessions (even if still kept alive in DSH's memory) delete normally.
- Deletion goes through DSH's own workspace-registry write paths (`detachSession` / `unarchiveSession` / `unpinSession`), so persisted state stays consistent.
- Routes are same-origin fenced; only requests coming from the DSH UI itself are accepted.

## Install

This plugin targets DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and newer `0.2.x` releases (currently verified on `0.2.1-rc.2`), and is linked into the `desktop` profile as a local directory:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:/absolute/path/dsh-session-delete"
```

Then **restart DSH** for it to take effect.

You can also edit `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` manually:

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-session-delete": "link:/absolute/path/dsh-session-delete"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // ... existing ...
        "@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-session-delete"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Then run `pnpm install` in the profile directory and restart DSH.

## Usage

1. In the session list on the left, hover a session and click its "…".
2. Choose **Delete session**.
3. Click **Delete** in the confirmation dialog.

> ⚠️ Deletion is **permanent and irreversible**. Make sure the session really is no longer needed.

## Limitations / notes

- This is a community plugin built on DSH's public extension points (the session-menu slot `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` plus host-side file/registry cleanup). If a future DSH release ships an official "delete session" API, prefer that.
- Running sessions refuse deletion; if you really need one gone, stop it first (finish/archive its work) and then delete.
- The full-text search index is a rebuildable read model of DSH's; right after a delete there may be briefly stale results until the next rebuild.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Sub2api account quotas and usage monitoring
plugins.readme_text:
# sub2api Account Usage Monitor

English | [中文](<docs/zh.md>)

`dsh-sub2api-monitor` is a DSH desktop plugin compatible with DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. It provides only a usage entry in the conversation title bar, with no sidebar entry, full page, or centered dialog. The title-bar popover has a maximum width of 700px and adapts to the viewport, balancing two-column cards with readability. Clicking outside, pressing Esc, or clicking Close dismisses it; clicking inside does not. It does not modify DSH core or start additional processes or HTTP services.

## Data and refresh

The Host reads the paginated account list, each account's `/usage`, and `/today-stats` through the management API. It refreshes every 60 seconds by default, processing at most 3 accounts concurrently. The Client reads the local cache every 10 seconds; manual refresh has a minimum interval of 10 seconds. All timers and requests are disposed of on plugin unload. Operations are read-only: the plugin does not call account start/stop, credential refresh, or quota-reset endpoints.

- Quota windows: 5-hour, 7-day, and upstream Sonnet/Opus windows, showing usage percentages and relative reset times, with full timestamps on hover. Anthropic explicitly uses `source=passive`, matching the site's passive sampling; the default active endpoint may omit weekly quotas.
- Compact, responsive cards retain today's statistics and abbreviate large numbers. The top explanation area and search box are removed; synchronization status appears as a title-bar dot.
- Subscription type: only allowlisted scalar values from `credentials.plan_type` are extracted, displayed separately from authentication methods such as OAuth. `promax` is shown as the site's corresponding `Pro 500`; missing values display “Unknown subscription”. The credentials object is never passed through.
- Today's requests, tokens, and cost use the Shanghai time zone. Costs use sub2api's accounting basis and are not equivalent to the provider's actual bill.
- Highlights at 80%/95%; the conversation summary counts accounts needing attention. System notifications are not currently sent.
- Unknown fields remain unknown. Partial failures are marked separately; list failures retain old data with a stale indicator. Upstream snapshots may predate collection; source timestamps are shown when supplied by the API.

## Account details

Click a card (or press Enter/Space) to open details within the same popover; Back returns to the list. Details load `/admin/accounts/:id/stats?days=30&timezone=Asia%2FShanghai` only on demand, cache for 60 seconds, and coalesce concurrent requests. Only known collected account IDs are accepted, redirects are rejected, and the Host projects allowlisted fields. No historical database or background history polling is added.

The view shows period totals, reported window length and recorded date range, daily request/Token/account-cost bars, model ranking by Token with expandable input/output/cache composition, active-day averages, peak days, and mean request duration. Missing dates are not filled with zeros. This covers only calls through sub2api; costs are not subscription bills, and mean duration is not time to first token. Account costs use `actual_cost` for daily records and `account_cost` for models; missing fields stay unknown. Errors offer retry; leaving details aborts the UI request, while shared Host work is bounded by timeout and unload cancellation.

## Installation and plugin configuration

Install the npm package `dsh-sub2api-monitor` in DSH's Plugins page. Open the configuration form in the plugin details, fill in the following fields, and save. Configuration is embedded directly in the plugin information page rather than registering a host settings page; the Configuration button at the top of the usage popover also opens it. DSH's settings service writes configuration to the profile; no plugin source edits are needed. The read endpoint returns only non-sensitive fields, the credential reference name, and whether a key is set. Leaving the key input blank preserves the existing value; the first save requires a key. Saves use revisions to detect concurrent conflicts and do not automatically overwrite changes from another window.

Disable the old `sub2api-monitor` and earlier `myspace-sub2api-monitor` packages before enabling the new package to avoid duplicate collection. After moving parameters into plugin configuration, uninstall the old package. Both the component ID and configuration namespace are `dsh-sub2api-monitor`; connection configuration is managed only by the DSH profile. When upgrading to 0.1.0, also replace the old component ID in the profile with the new ID while preserving its config fields; do not just swap packages and lose configuration.

- `baseUrl`: the site's API address, including `/api/v1`.
- `adminApiKeyEnv`: credential reference (environment-variable-style name) for the administrator API key; default `SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY`. The profile stores only this name. A key entered in the form is written to the DSH credentials service (`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` with the local provider), not to plugin configuration. The process environment or a `.env` file can also supply it; an inherited environment value is read-only and disables the key input.
- `allowInsecureHttp`: off by default; enable only after explicitly accepting plaintext risks.
- `intervalSeconds`: 30–3600 seconds; default 60 seconds.
- `primaryAccounts`: select multiple accounts from a checkbox list loaded automatically from the unfiltered Host cache. Refresh Accounts fetches upstream data using the saved connection (10-second cooldown). Missing selected accounts are retained; failures never clear selections. Internally stored as exact names, empty by default. Primary cards show a badge.
- `primaryFirst`: defaults to true; places primary accounts before the selected secondary ordering.
- `displayFilter`: `all`, `primary`, `available`, or `attention`. Attention includes unavailable accounts, failed usage/statistics requests, and usage at or above 80%.
- `sortBy`: `available` (default), `name`, `usage-desc`, or `usage-asc`. Usage sorting compares the highest known usage percentage across windows; unknown values sort last. Filtering does not change upstream collection. Settings persist in the profile and are applied to subsequent cache reads. The title-bar count reflects the filtered set; the web dashboard remains independent.

Only the Host resolves the key, once per request, so rotation takes effect on the next refresh without a restart. It is never injected into the Client module, usage endpoint, or profile. The credentials file is plaintext with owner-only permissions; it is not disk encryption.

```json
{
  "baseUrl": "https://your-sub2api.example/api/v1",
  "adminApiKeyEnv": "SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY",
  "allowInsecureHttp": false,
  "intervalSeconds": 60
}
```

Set `allowInsecureHttp` to `true` only after explicitly accepting plaintext transport risks. To rotate the key, enter a new one in the form, or update the credential through the DSH credentials service; no reinstallation is needed.

Upgrading from 0.1.x: the plaintext `adminApiKey` field has been removed. Move its value into the credentials service under `SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY` (or re-enter it in the form), then delete `adminApiKey` from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.

The old standalone JSON configuration and `SUB2API_MONITOR_CONFIG` environment variable are no longer read. Delete the old configuration file after migration, keeping plugin configuration as the single authority.

Upstream redirects are rejected to prevent key leakage. The frontend receives only allowlisted display fields, excluding credentials, extra, notes, and raw errors.

The local `/sub2api-monitor/api` accepts only loopback requests, a valid local Host, a same-origin Origin when present, and the custom header `X-Sub2api-Monitor: 1`. CORS is not enabled. Remote browsers and cross-machine connections are not currently supported.

## Installation and verification

The only dependency is the official `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` configuration schema package; there is no generation step

plugins.description: DSH 人设卡插件：按会话绑定的人设卡片与全局提示词段落，支持导入 .md 人设文件。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-persona-cards —— 人设卡 在 **设置 → 人设卡** 里管理人设，在**每个会话**里选用哪一套。选中的那张会拼进 系统提示词，排在官方部署人设之后、所有工具说明之前。**改完下一个模型步骤就生效，不用重启。** **默认不注入任何人设** —— 要用哪张，得在会话里显式选。 另有一段**全局设置**：不挑会话、不挑人设，写了就永远注入（排在人设之前）。 见下面「全局设置」一节。 --- ## 功能 - **设置里的独立一页**：左侧设置导航新增「人设卡」，与「通用」「模型」「插件」并列。 - **全局设置**（与人设卡并列的一块）：一段对所有会话都成立的附加正文， **不管会话有没有选人设都会注入**，且排在人设之前；留空即不注入。见下面专节。 - **多张卡**：新建 / 编辑 / 删除，每张卡有名字、正文、启用开关。 - **卡片态 / 编辑态分离**：列表默认是只读卡片（标题 + 正文预览 + 开关）， 点「编辑」才展开输入框，点「完成」回到卡片态、点「取消」直接丢弃草稿。 - **会话级选择**：会话输入框左侧有个「人设」选择器。选中只作用于**当前会话**， 别的会话不受影响；不选就是「不使用人设」。 - **自动保存**：编辑完成时立即落盘；开关 / 删除 / 新建立即落盘；全局设置为 700ms 防抖落盘。 - **零污染**：没选人设、全局设置也留空时，插件对那个会话的提示词**完全不存在** （空段落会被 DSH 自动丢弃）。 ### 全局设置：唯一一段"无条件的"注入 | 项 | 值 | |---|---| | 在哪写 | 设置 → 人设卡 → 页面顶部「全局设置」框 | | 何时注入 | **永远** —— 不挑会话、不挑人设、不挑启用状态 | | 注入位置 | 官方部署人设(0) **之后**、选中的人设卡(100) **之前** → `order = 90` | | 段落名 | `persona-cards:global` | | 存哪 | `settings.json`（与人设卡 `cards.json` 分开） | | 空值语义 | 全空白 = 没写 = 整段被 DSH 丢弃，插件对这个会话不产生任何提示词 | 排序上刻意取 90：它是官方 `SECTION_ORDERS` 里 `DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_PREFIX(0)` 与 本插件人设段 `(100)` 之间的空位，不会和任何官方段撞号。语义是「全局总纲 → 具体身份」： 对所有会话一致的要求先立，会话选的人设后置覆盖。 **为什么单独一段，而不是拼进人设段**：两段的生效条件完全不同（人设段"没选就空"、 全局段"写了就在"）。合成一段就得在渲染时拼字符串，还要额外处理"只有全局没有人设" 的边界；分开之后 DSH 的 `renderPrompt()` 空段丢弃规则天然把两种情况都处理干净。 **为什么单独一个文件**：卡片与全局设置的自动保存是各自独立触发的，共用一个文件 就意味着每次落盘都写全量，一边的写入会把另一边刚改的内容按旧值覆盖回去。 分开之后两个文件各自「临时文件 + rename」，互不干扰。 `{{model}}` / `{{cwd}}` / `{{provider}}` 的引用规则**与人设完全一致**：落盘前过同一道 白名单闸门（`normalizeBody()`），其余引用一律拒绝保存并说明原因。 其中只有 `{{model}}` / `{{provider}}` 是 DSH 0.2.1 注册的官方提示词变量；`{{cwd}}` **不是**（0.2.0 曾有，0.2.1 已移除）。本插件仍支持它，但由插件自己在渲染时从 `agent.session.header.cwd` 本地展开，两个段落都设了 `interpolate: false`，不会交给 DSH 官方插值。`{{cwd}}` 取的是会话 header 记录的**原始工作目录**，不是 working-directory 服务变更后的当前目录。 ### 语义：设置页管仓库，会话管这次用哪张 | 层 | 存哪 | 作用 | |---|---|---| | 卡片 | `cards.json` | 设置页维护 | | 启用开关 | 同上 | **只决定这张卡进不进备选池**，不替任何会话做决定 | | 会话 → 卡片 绑定 | `session-cards.json` | 会话界面的选择器写入 | | 全局设置 | `settings.json` | 设置页维护，**无条件注入**，与会话/人设无关 | | 注入什么 | —— | **全局设置（若有）+「绑了就用绑的那张；没绑就什么都不注入」** | 这个设计解决了一个实际问题：把几张卡全启用，新会话**不会**把几个人格叠加成 互相打架的身份指令 —— 因为「启用」不等于「生效」。 会话 id 来自段落 text 函数收到的组装上下文 —— `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent` 的 `assembleContextFor()` 返回的是 `{ agent, scope: agent, signal? }`， 所以 `context.agent.id` 就是当前会话。拿不到 agent（或绑的卡被停用/清空/删除）时 一律按「不注入」处理，不会抛错、也不会误注入别的卡。 ### ⚠️ 为什么选择器不在「新建会话」界面 试过了，**DSH 的插槽体系里没有干净的位置**： `sessionId`，所以这些槽一律不渲染。 2. hero 区唯一能挂东西的是 `conversation.hero.agentPreset`，但它是 **single 槽且已被官方占用** （`replaceRisk: shadows-shipped-ui`）—— 用它就得顶掉官方的 agent 预设选择器。 所以选择器放在 **composer 工具行左侧**（`conversation.input.left`，list 槽、空着、`replaceRisk: none`）。 效果是：**发出第一条消息后选择器出现**，之后随时可切；新会话的第一条消息用设置里的默认规则。 ## 安装 包已链接进 desktop profile。手工装的三步（本机开发用）： 1. 包目录 junction 到 `/node_modules/dsh-persona-cards` 2. `/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-persona-cards": "0.2.0"` 3. `/cordis.patch.yml` 追加 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 insert 块 官方装法：`dsh plugin --profile

数据 | 项 | 位置 | |---|---| | 卡片文件 | `$DSH_HOME/persona-cards/cards.json` | | 全局设置 | `$DSH_HOME/persona-cards/settings.json` | | 会话绑定 | `$DSH_HOME/persona-cards/session-cards.json` | | 诊断输出 | `$DSH_HOME/persona-cards/diag.json`（排查注册问题用，可删） | `$DSH_HOME` 解析顺序：环境变量 `DSH_HOME` → `~/.dsh`。 默认即 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\persona-cards\cards.json`。**同目录下已有的 `.md` 人设文件不会被读写或修改。** > **这些文件不在会话日志里。** 卡片、全局设置、会话绑定都是插件自己的外部状态， > session log 不记录“这一轮用了哪张卡”，所以 fork / replay / 换一台机器 / 删除 > `$DSH_HOME/persona-cards` 后都无法从日志重建绑定；插件会按“没绑定”处理，静默 > 不注入，而不是报错。存储格式（version 1）保持不变。 ## 注入位置 两个提示词段落，`order` 取自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` 的 `SECTION_ORDERS`： ``` HARNESS_IDENTITY(-1000) → DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_PREFIX(0) → ★persona-cards:global(90) → ★persona-cards:user(100) → PLAN_POLICY(500) → TEAM_POLICY(600) → 各工具说明(1000+) ``` | 段落名 | order | 内容 | |---|---|---| | `persona-cards:global` | 90 | 全局设置，非空就注入，与上下文无关 | | `persona-cards:user` | 100 | 当前会话选中的那张人设卡，没选就是空串（整段被丢弃） | ## DSH 0.2.0 兼容性（重要） DSH 从 `0.1.7-rc.2` 升到 `0.2.0-rc.1` 后，cordis 收紧了 ctx 代理： **没声明 `inject` 的服务属性访问会直接抛错** —— `cannot get property "X" without inject`（`cordis/lib/index.js` 的 `ReflectService.handler.get`）。 `connection.rpc.handle()` 内部是 `register(owner = this.ctx, …)` → `owner.webServer.register(route)`，而 `this.ctx` 解析成**调用方 fiber 的 ctx** （官方注释明写："channel registrations belong to the caller fiber"）。 本插件刻意不声明 inject（声明会把 apply 推迟，见 `whenService` 注释）， 于是官方通道整条挂掉，表现就是设置页报： ``` 读取失败：transport failure for /persona-cards/state: HTTP 405 ``` （405 = 请求落到了 fallback，说明路由压根没注册。） **修法：官方通道优先，失败自动降级。** 降级路径用 `ctx.get('webServer')` —— 官方给的服务可选访问形式，**不受 inject 约束** —— 自己挂 `{kind:'prefix'}` 路由，信任校验复用 `connection.admit(req)`： 它是实例方法，只读 `trustedHosts` / `browserAuth` / `operator` 三个实例属性， 完全不碰 ctx。 **已在真实运行环境实测过**（建了个独立探针包，新包名没有 ESM 缓存所以当场加载）： | 检查项 | 结果 | |---|---| | `ctx.get('webServer')` | `object` | | `webServer.register` | `function` | | `ctx.get('connection')` / `.admit` | `object` / `function` | | 路由注册 | 成功 | | 未认证请求打到该路由 | **401**（不是 404/405），且确实进了处理器 | 401 是预期的：命令行的裸请求没有浏览器认证 cookie，被信任栅栏拦下； 页面内发起的同源请求会带 cookie，正常通过。 ## DSH 0.2.1 变量变化（重要） DSH 0.2.1 的 `dsh-agent-loop` 只注册 `provider` 和 `model` 两个提示词变量； 0.2.0 里的 `cwd` 已被移除。官方文档明确要求从 persona / preset 的 `suffix` 中删掉 `Your working directory is {{cwd}}.`，否则引用未注册变量会让提示词组装在模型请求前 直接失败。 本插件不受影响，因为： - 两个提示词段落都用 `interpolate: false` 渲染，DSH 不会扫描卡片正文里的 `{{...}}`； - `{{cwd}}` 由 `renderVariables()` 从 `agent.session.header.cwd` 本地展开，缺值替换为 空串而不是抛错； - 落盘前的白名单校验沿用官方 `interpolate()` 的语法，保证存下来的正文在别处（例如 被复制进会做官方插值的 preset 段落）也不会带雷。 **不要把 `interpolate` 改回 `true`，也不要指望 DSH 替你展开 `{{cwd}}`。** `{{cwd}}` 是插件的本地变量：它取会话 header 的原始工作目录，不跟随 working-directory 服务后续的目录切换。 ## 两个保命设计（别改） 1. **`{{...}}` 闸门**。DSH 的官方插值会对每个段落扫 `{{...}}`，而 `interpolate()` 在三种情况下**直接抛异常**：引用了没注册的名字（`unknown prompt variable`）、 引用了已注册但本次组装没有值的变量、以及写法不合法 （`malformed prompt variable reference`）。0.2.1 只注册 `provider` / `model`； 0.2.0 里还能用的 `{{cwd}}` 现在会让整个模型步骤失败。 本插件的做法是**关闭官方插值 + 本地展开 + 落盘前白名单校验**： - 两个段落都设 `interpolate: false`，DSH 不会碰正文里的 `{{...}}`； - 渲染时只本地替换 `model` / `cwd` / `provider`，缺值给空串；`cwd` 取自 `agent.session.header.cwd`（会话创建时的原始目录，不是 working-directory 服务变更后的当前目录），它不是 DSH 官方变量； - **保存时**用 `scanVariableReferences()` 按官方 `interpolate()` 的语法扫正文 （包括「没有配对的单个 `{{` 当普通文本放行」），只放行这三个名字，其余引用 拒绝保存并说明原因。 全库扫过 DSH 的包（0.2.0 时是 289 个）：官方自己**没有任何内置段落**引用这些 变量 —— 它们就是留给插件/组合层用的。0.2.1 起官方变量只剩 `provider` / `model`， `cwd` 归本插件自己维护。 2. **不能用 `deployment:persona-prefix` 这个段名**。它归 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` 所有，而官方注释明写那个插件是 scope-only 的： 全局挂载会与注册表自身的注册相撞并 fail loud。所以本插件用自己的段名。 ##
